description:
Retrieve what was said on earnings calls, plus the print and the price move.

    Use this for one season across several names, or this season versus a
    prior season. Pass tickers you already have, or a sector label such as
    Financials or Technology. Banks, insurers, and brokers are Financials.
    Do not invent symbols.

    finance_search still answers when a company reports, the Earnings Deep
    Dive, and a request for the full transcript.

    Args:
        question: What to look for in the calls, such as credit costs or guidance.
        tickers: Symbols to search. Optional when sector is set.
        sector: SIC sector stored on the chunks, such as Financials or Technology.
        conference_from: Season start, YYYY-MM-DD, with conference_to.
        conference_to: Season end, YYYY-MM-DD.
        compare_from: Prior season start, with compare_to.
        compare_to: Prior season end.
        fiscal_year: Fiscal year, with fiscal_quarter, instead of dates.
        fiscal_quarter: Fiscal quarter 1-4.
        compare_fiscal_year: Prior fiscal year, with compare_fiscal_quarter.
        compare_fiscal_quarter: Prior fiscal quarter 1-4.
        last_n_quarters: Recent calls per ticker, 1-8. Not used with compare.
        chunks_per_ticker: Excerpts per call, 1-5. Default 3.

strategy_id.description: Strategy this call belongs to. UUID from list_strategies. The card this call writes keeps that id. Omit when the call is not part of a strategy.
strategy_id.title: Strategy Id

name: earnings_rag
title: Search earnings call evidence
